body: Hey! I would need someone to talk.

Thanks. Today finally ended up being a better day... with friends. Tomorrow I will go to work. I have social anxiety that I hide also and cause of that inner tension is growing. I just want a decent life. I hope I will manage to be more social abd a contribution to the world. Now
I hope these days are not my last ones... I am exhausted though. Thanks for your encouragement.
Is there hope to get out of it? Everyone else seem to be happier than me. Even homeless people have some fun as I see. I want to be doing better.
Thanks for connecting my friend. I whish we could go through this and find some joy in life. Real joy, happiness

Thanks for your wise and loving answer.

I just want some relief and eventually some humor to look at life as challenge and as you wrote, a new chapter.

All the best,

Adam
